entries.dialogueText: The four of us gathered around the dining room table. Monica ladled out bowls full of beef stew -- not my favorite, but a comforting dish nonetheless.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I know the past four years have be..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The past four years have tested ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "The past four years have tested our strength as a family."
entries.menuText: "The past four years have tested our strength as a family."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I was so busy focusing on the need..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was so busy focusing on the needs of the Sordish people that I forgot about Sordland's most important people: my own wife and children."
entries.menuText: "I was so busy focusing on the needs of the Sordish people that I forgot about Sordland's most important people: my own family."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I let my power get to my head. I b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I let my power get to my head. I became unrecognizable to myself -- and to all of you."
entries.menuText: "I let my power get to my head. I became unrecognizeable to myself -- and to all of you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've done some unforgivable things..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've done some unforgivable things. Especially to you, Monica."
entries.menuText: "I've done some unforgivable things. Especially to you, Monica."

entries.menuText: "I hope someday, we'll be able to put this behind us and be a family again."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica looked at me sadly. She slow..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica looked at me sadly. She slowly shook her head.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I swear to you all, I'll learn fro..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swear to you all, I'll learn from my mistakes during my next term."
entries.menuText: "I swear to you all, I'll learn from my mistakes during my next term."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""As a first step towards that, I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a first step towards that, I'm retiring from politics at the end of this term."
entries.menuText: "As a first step towards that, I'm retiring from politics at the end of this term."

entries.dialogueText: "But right now, there's no time. We need to get out of Sordland. All of us."
entries.menuText: "But right now, there's no time. We need to get out of Sordland. All of us."
